add-to-cart-button.label: Add to cart
add-to-cart-button.guest-full: Your cart already holds as many different products as it can. Remove one, or sign in, to add another.

cart-page.no-shipping-needed: Nothing in this cart needs shipping.
cart-page.confirm-clear: Remove the item from your cart? | Remove all {count} items from your cart?
cart-page.error-cart-changed: Your cart changed on the server since this page loaded — it has been refreshed, please review it and try again.
cart-page.error-insufficient-stock: Some items in your cart are no longer available in the quantity you asked for.
cart-page.shortfall-line: {title}: you asked for {requested}, and there is not enough in stock
cart-page.error-address-not-found: We couldn't find the shipping address for this order — check your saved addresses and try again.
cart-page.error-billing-address-required: Every order needs a billing address for its invoice — choose or add one to continue.
cart-page.error-shipping-method-weight: Your basket is too heavy for the chosen shipping method — pick another one.
cart-page.error-shipping-method-generic: That shipping method could not be set — pick another one.
cart-page.error-ship-to-country-not-supported: We don't ship to that address's country — choose or add an address in a country we deliver to.
cart-page.error-product-unavailable: Some products in your cart are no longer available — remove them to check out.
cart-page.error-open-order-limit: You already have unpaid orders open. Pay or cancel one of them before placing another.
cart-page.merge-alert-title: Your guest cart was added to your cart
cart-page.merge-alert-intro: Some lines are not what you chose, or are not all in stock:
cart-page.merge-alert-line: {title}: you chose {requested}, your cart now has {resulting}.
cart-page.merge-reason-summed: Your cart already held some of it, so the two were added together.
cart-page.merge-reason-capped: That is the most one line can hold.
cart-page.merge-reason-unavailable: It is no longer available, so it was not added.
cart-page.error-guest-merge: We could not add the cart you built before signing in to your account. It stays on this device and will be tried again the next time you sign in.
cart-page.error-guest-merge-dropped: We could not add the cart you built before signing in to your account, and it cannot be fixed by trying again, so it was cleared from this device.
cart-page.error-cart-empty: This cart is already empty. If you just placed an order it went through: check your orders.
cart-page.error-checkout-in-flight: Your order is still being processed. Check your orders in a moment before trying again.
cart-page.order-placed-after-error: Your order was placed, but the confirmation did not reach us. Here are your orders.

guest-cart-page.intro: This cart is saved on this device. Sign in to check out: what is in it is added to your account's cart.
guest-cart-page.vanished-toast: A product in your cart is no longer available and was removed. | {count} products in your cart are no longer available and were removed.
guest-cart-page.vanished-note: A product that is no longer available was removed from your cart. | {count} products that are no longer available were removed from your cart.
